content: Catch-up vs live subscription pattern: EventStore persistent subscriptions deliver events from a saved checkpoint (catch-up mode), then transition to live mode once caught up — this is the correct pattern for projections. PubSub (message bus) alone is insufficient for projections because events published before the projector started are lost. Projectors need: (1) on startup, subscribe to EventStore from last checkpoint (catch-up all missed events in order), (2) after catch-up, continue receiving live events from the same subscription. The EventStore subscription handles both phases transparently. For replay/rebuild: reset checkpoint to -1 (origin), restart the GenServer, and it replays from the beginning.
